points.description: States that the stack operation corresponding to enqueue is "push" (the exact term push; adding an element to the top of the stack).

rubric.notes: Full 5 marks only if the student names "push" as the stack operation. Any other operation (e.g. pop, peek, dequeue, insert) or a vague description without the term "push" earns 0. A wrong extra operation offered alongside push (e.g. "push or pop") also earns 0.
